sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Mr Toro 2 is a 2D platformer where you control Mr Toro as he navigates through 8 challenging levels. Your goal is to collect as much money as possible while avoiding enemies, spikes, saws, and flying robots that will stop at nothing to hinder your progress. The game is designed to increase in difficulty as you progress through the levels, with new obstacles and challenges emerging to test your skills.

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet addictive, making it easy for anyone to pick up and start playing. The controls are responsive and intuitive, with WASD or arrow keys controlling Mr Toro's movement. You can also use the W or up arrow key twice to execute a double jump, which comes in handy when navigating through tight spaces or avoiding obstacles.

One of the standout features of Mr Toro 2 is its level design. Each level is carefully crafted to provide a unique and challenging experience, with multiple paths and secrets to discover. The game also features a variety of power-ups and bonuses that can help you on your journey, such as coins that grant you extra lives or speed boosters that allow you to sprint through levels at incredible velocities.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter a range of enemies and obstacles that will try to stop you from reaching the red flag at the end of each level. From the classic spikes and saws to the more modern flying robots, each enemy requires a different strategy to evade or defeat. With practice and patience, you'll develop the skills and reflexes needed to conquer even the toughest levels.
